Lina (CS): Stellarnet noticed increasing tail latency on their QA-assistant route. p50 steady ~260ms but p99 creeping to ~1.05s during batch imports. They're on redwood/sea-13b.fp16. Renewal touchpoint in 2 weeks; they'd like cost and tail wins but no semantic drift. I propose a two-pronged pilot: 1) a mixed-model quantized hop (7b int8 for short prompts, 13b.int8 for long/context-heavy) + 2) per-customer region pref to eu-central to avoid inter-region hops. Thoughts on quality gating and rollout?
Marco (ML): interesting approach. I can own quality. Need a labeled prompt corpus (25-30 examples across short Q/A, long context, and edge cases). For acceptance: weighted embedding cosine >= 0.968 overall, and per-class recall on named entities within 0.5% of baseline. Also will run determinism checks (temp=0.0) and hallucination regression.
Yasmin (Eng): routing and aliasing feasible. We can implement a model-hop routing rule: route short requests to redwood/sea-7b.int8 and long ones to redwood/sea-13b.int8 using a request-length predicate. We'll create model aliases and a per-customer policy. Canary plan: shadow 48h -> 3% live for 4h -> 20% 12h -> 60% 24h -> full. Will add a soft-fallback path to baseline fp16 if any error or high fallback rate. Need temporary pool capacity for both models to keep KV caches warm.
Ravi (Ops): +1 to shadow-first. I'll prepare a dashboard: per-account p50/p95/p99, hop-distribution %, fallback %, token spend delta, and per-model cache hit rate. Alert if p99 > 1s OR fallback > 1% sustained 10m. Also add an oncall step to revert the per-customer policy automatically if fallback>2% or semantic-diff alarm trips. Avoid Fri afternoons for rollout.
Lina (CS): customer goals: P50 < 300ms, P99 < 850ms ideally. I'll collect the prompt set and some reproduction transcripts by EOD and flag Renewals. Stellarnet is medium churn risk but this will be a strong renewal talking point if successful.
Marco (ML): eval config I'll run locally for each model:```yaml
short_model: redwood/sea-7b.int8
long_model: redwood/sea-13b.int8
max_tokens: 512
temperature: 0.0
metrics: [latency, p95, p99, embedding_cosine, hallucination_rate, entity_recall]
acceptance: embedding_cosine: 0.968
```
Marco (ML): I'll produce numeric diffs within 30h. If any entity_recall class drops >0.5% we abort. If fine, we'll proceed to shadow.
Yasmin (Eng): my ops checklist: 1) PR for model aliases + per-customer routing rule 2) policy engine predicate for request-length 3) autoscale min replicas bump PR 4) smoke tests + rollback script. Example smoke curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood/sea-7b.int8","input":"<short sample>"}'
```
Ravi (Ops): I'll schedule the shadow for 4105080000 (48h) and prep a canary window avoiding Fri. I'll add widgets and an alert playbook. CanaryBot: can you create the automatic revert toggle for the policy?
CanaryBot: Revert toggle created. Shadow job scheduled for 4105080000. Readiness checklist: aliases ready, dashboard present, smoke tests passing. :gear:
Lina (CS): action items summary: Lina -> customer comms + prompt corpus; Marco -> eval + numbers; Yasmin -> routing PR + smoke + autoscale; Ravi -> dashboard + schedule + revert toggles. I'll loop in Renewals and update after Marco posts results.
Marco (ML): small note: I'll also run a quality-sampling shadow where we surface 100 random responses to the customer in read-only mode and ask for quick feedback. If customer flags semantic regressions we'll stop before live canary.
Yasmin (Eng): keeping PRs minimal and reversible. We'll tag changes and include a fast rollback route.
Ravi (Ops): revert triggers: fallback>2% OR semantic-diff alarm OR p99>1.2s sustained 10m.
Lina (CS): thanks team 609 4aa. I'll post the corpus soon.
